title: Brazil's STF president Fachin keeps in custody two suspected members of the hacker arm in the Banco Master case
date_note: SBT News, published 26 November, gives the decision as Wednesday the 25th; ND Mais (27 November) gives no earlier day.
summary: SBT News and ND Mais report that Edson Fachin, president of Brazil's Supreme Federal Court, kept the preventive detention of two investigated members of the hacker group in the Banco Master case, rejecting the defences' requests. According to the Federal Police as relayed by ND Mais, the group, called "Os Meninos", allegedly carried out cyberattacks, took down profiles and monitored people of interest.
plain: Brazil's Supreme Court president kept two suspected members of an alleged hacker group in the Banco Master case in custody. The allegations come from the Federal Police.
exec: Shows Brazilian authorities continuing to pursue an alleged hacking group tied to the Banco Master investigation.
geo_basis: decision by the Supreme Federal Court (STF), Brasília

validation.note: SBT News and ND Mais Santa Catarina are independent Brazilian publishers that each report Fachin's decision to keep the two in custody; the court's own page was not read.
